state: Private composed route using already shipped native stages.
native_domain: Aligned, C-order, owning, plain ndarray with ordinary native-endian uint8/float32/float64. Rank 2 without channel axis or rank 3 with exact integer channel axis. Input and output 1..512 per extent and at most 262144 elements. Ordinary finite scale (1,4], scalar sigma 0..4 or default, order 0/1, reflect/constant/wrap, ordinary Boolean preserve_range, finite floating inputs and cval within ±65536.
order: Convert first. Reduce applies Gaussian then resize. Expand applies resize then Gaussian. Gaussian gets its own border convention and an empty_like destination. Resize uses shipped translation/grid mode/clipping, with anti_aliasing=False. Channel axis is normalized by rank; shape uses ceil and no channel growth or Gaussian.
ownership: Both stages call the already exported native functions. The Python composition adds no compiled stage, provider replacement, or standalone C++ ABI.
compatibility: Unsupported inputs and options delegate the whole operation without running a partial composition. NaN warnings and error ordering retain the pinned profile-specific upstream behavior.
